introduction: Hub's git server (internal/gitserver) decides who may clone, fetch and push a workspace repository by calling the shared workspace access rule wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspaceAt with a need taken from the git service requested: members of the workspace's org may clone and fetch, only the owner and admin tokens may push, and every other caller gets today's answer.

glossary.admin token: An af_admin_ credential (CredentialType "admin_token"); distinct from an API key whose user has the admin role.
glossary.git site: wsaccess.RefusalSite{Method: c.Request().Method, Route: c.Path(), Status: 404, Surface: wsaccess.SurfaceGit}, the refusal site the git server reports bound-token refusals with.
glossary.member: A user with a row in org_members for the workspace's org_id who is neither the workspace owner nor an admin token (wsaccess.AccessMember, spec 35).
glossary.need: wsaccess.Need value passed to AuthorizeWorkspaceAt: NeedRead for upload-pack requests, NeedWrite for receive-pack requests. The git server never uses NeedPrivate.
glossary.pkt-line error: A git smart-HTTP error body: Content-Type text/plain and the pkt-line encoding of "ERR <message>\n", written by writePktLineError.
glossary.stranger: A caller that is not the workspace owner, not a member of the workspace's org and not an admin token (wsaccess.AccessNone).

requirements.title: One access decision, made by wsaccess
requirements.rationale: The git server must apply hub's shared workspace access rule instead of keeping its own copy of the ownership rule.

criteria.condition: gitResolverMiddleware has resolved a ready workspace and calls authorizeGitAccess with a non-nil AuthInfo
criteria.action: obtain the decision from exactly one call to wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspaceAt(db, info, ws.Slug, need, site) where site is the git site, without checking CredentialType == "admin_token", comparing UserID with OwnerID, or calling wsaccess.DeniesWorkspace itself
criteria.contract: returns nil when AuthorizeWorkspaceAt returns status 0; otherwise writes a pkt-line refusal and returns errAccessDenied

criteria.condition: the request context carries no AuthInfo
criteria.action: return before calling AuthorizeWorkspaceAt
criteria.contract: returns echo.NewHTTPError(401)

criteria.action: contain no Go code outside test files that compares a workspace owner_id or OwnerID field with the caller's UserID

keep its name, its signature (c echo.Context, db *sql.DB, ws *workspaceInfo) error and its errAccessDenied contract, so that gitResolverMiddleware returns nil without writing a second response when it receives errAccessDenied
criteria.contract: on errAccessDenied the client receives exactly one response, the pkt-line refusal authorizeGitAccess wrote

requirements.title: Need derived from the git request
requirements.rationale: Read and write must be distinguished before the handler runs so that the access rule can refuse a member's push.

criteria.condition: the matched route template c.Path() is /git/:org/:slug.git/git-receive-pack, or is /git/:org/:slug.git/info/refs and the first service query value is git-receive-pack
criteria.action: pass wsaccess.NeedWrite to AuthorizeWorkspaceAt

criteria.condition: the matched route template is /git/:org/:slug.git/git-upload-pack, or is /git/:org/:slug.git/info/refs and the first service query value is anything other than git-receive-pack, including missing or empty
criteria.action: pass wsaccess.NeedRead to AuthorizeWorkspaceAt

criteria.condition: a member or owner sends GET .../info/refs with a missing or invalid service value
criteria.action: grant access with NeedRead and let handleInfoRefs answer its existing invalid-service refusal
criteria.contract: HTTP 403, Content-Type text/plain, pkt-line body "ERR invalid or missing service parameter\n", identical for member and owner

criteria.action: for any git request, pass only NeedRead or NeedWrite to AuthorizeWorkspaceAt and never NeedPrivate

requirements.title: Members clone and fetch
requirements.rationale: Spec 35 lists org workspaces to members with their hub_url, so members must be able to read the repository it points to.

criteria.condition: a member's API key, or a member's PAT holding git:read or git:write, sends GET .../info/refs?service=git-upload-pack for a workspace in their org with a ready clone
criteria.action: serve the upload-pack ref advertisement exactly as it serves the workspace owner
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the same Content-Type and the same advertised refs as the owner's response

criteria.condition: a member's API key, or a member's PAT holding git:read or git:write, sends POST .../git-upload-pack for a workspace in their org with a ready clone
criteria.action: serve the pack exactly as it serves the workspace owner for the same request body
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the same Content-Type and pack content as the owner's response

criteria.condition: a member's PAT holds neither git:read nor git:write and sends an upload-pack request
criteria.action: grant access in the resolver and refuse in requireGitScope as for an owner's PAT
criteria.contract: HTTP 403 "insufficient git permissions" from echo.NewHTTPError, identical to the owner's PAT answer

criteria.condition: a user's org_members row for the workspace's org is deleted between two git requests
criteria.action: read membership on the second request and treat the user as a stranger
criteria.contract: the second request gets HTTP 404 with pkt-line body "ERR repository not found\n"

criteria.condition: a member runs git clone and then git fetch of /git/<org>/<slug>.git with their API key
criteria.action: complete both operations through the git CLI
criteria.contract: git clone and git fetch exit 0 and the local refs equal the refs the owner sees

requirements.title: Members cannot push
requirements.rationale: Members have read-only access; a 403 tells them and their tooling why a push fails.

criteria.condition: a member sends GET .../info/refs?service=git-receive-pack or POST .../git-receive-pack, with an API key or a PAT holding any scopes
criteria.action: refuse the request before git.PlainOpen and before the handler runs
criteria.contract: HTTP 403, Content-Type text/plain, pkt-line body "ERR org members have read-only access to this workspace\n" using the message AuthorizeWorkspaceAt returns

criteria.condition: a member's POST .../git-receive-pack carrying a pack and ref updates is refused
criteria.action: write no object and no ref, not call the pre-receive hook, not update head_sha, not reset the worktree, emit no hub.git.push audit event and not run the post-push hook
criteria.contract: the workspace's refs, objects, head_sha and audit event count are unchanged after the request

criteria.condition: a member runs git push to the workspace with their API key
criteria.action: refuse at ref discovery
criteria.contract: git push exits non-zero, its output contains "org members have read-only access to this workspace", and the workspace refs are unchanged

criteria.action: emit no audit event for a refused member push request

requirements.title: Refusal statuses written as pkt-lines
requirements.rationale: Git clients read pkt-line errors, and existing tests and users read the git server's existing "repository not found" text.

criteria.condition: AuthorizeWorkspaceAt returns status 404
criteria.action: write the git server's not-found text instead of wsaccess's message and return errAccessDenied
criteria.contract: HTTP 404, Content-Type text/plain, pkt-line body "ERR repository not found\n"

criteria.condition: AuthorizeWorkspaceAt returns status 403
criteria.action: write the returned message as a pkt-line error and return errAccessDenied
criteria.contract: HTTP 403, Content-Type text/plain, pkt-line body "ERR <returned message>\n"

criteria.condition: AuthorizeWorkspaceAt returns status 500 or any other non-zero status other than 403 and 404, including after a membership or binding database error
criteria.action: deny access, write a pkt-line internal error and return errAccessDenied
criteria.contract: HTTP 500, Content-Type text/plain, pkt-line body "ERR internal server error\n"; the repository is not opened or served

requirements.title: Everyone else answers as today
requirements.rationale: Only members' answers change; strangers, owners and admin tokens keep their exact status and body.

criteria.condition: a stranger's API key or PAT sends a request to any of the three git routes of a workspace with a ready clone
criteria.action: refuse without a binding lookup and without a bound-refusal report
criteria.contract: HTTP 404, Content-Type text/plain, pkt-line body "ERR repository not found\n"; no BoundRefusal is observed

criteria.condition: the workspace owner or an admin token sends a request to any of the three git routes
criteria.action: answer with today's status and body, including the scope 403 "insufficient git permissions" for an owner's PAT that lacks the required git scope
criteria.contract: status and body equal to the pre-change answers

criteria.action: treat an API key whose user has Role admin as owner, member or stranger by the same rule as any other API key, never as an admin token
decide API key and admin token requests without querying the binding table, so they get the same answers with that table dropped

criteria.condition: a blocked user's credential is presented to any git route
criteria.action: refuse before the resolver runs
criteria.contract: HTTP 401

requirements.title: Bound tokens keep spec 33 and 34 behaviour
requirements.rationale: Token binding narrows access after the access decision, so it must hold for members as it does for owners.

criteria.condition: a PAT bound to workspace S requests another workspace whose access step grants its user (owner or member)
criteria.action: refuse the request and report the refusal exactly once to the refusal observer with the git site
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"; one BoundRefusal with Method, Route = c.Path(), Status 404 and Surface "git"

criteria.condition: the binding lookup fails with a database error
criteria.action: not serve the repository
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 pkt-line "ERR internal server error\n"

criteria.condition: a member's PAT bound to the workspace W requests W
criteria.action: answer exactly as for an unbound PAT of the same user and scopes: grant upload-pack requests and refuse receive-pack requests with the member 403
criteria.contract: upload-pack HTTP 200; receive-pack HTTP 403 pkt-line "ERR org members have read-only access to this workspace\n"

criteria.condition: a stranger's PAT bound to some workspace requests W
criteria.action: refuse without reporting a bound refusal
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"; no BoundRefusal is observed

requirements.title: Order of checks
requirements.rationale: Moving the access decision would change strangers' answers and bound-refusal reporting, which is out of scope.

criteria.action: apply the checks in this order: GitAuthMiddleware (401), requireDotGitSuffix (404), the resolver's own lookup (unknown slug or org mismatch 404 "repository not found", database error plain 500, clone not ready 404 "repository not available"), authorizeGitAccess, git.PlainOpen (500), then the handler's invalid-service 403 and scope 403
criteria.contract: each request receives the status of the first check in this order that refuses it

criteria.condition: any caller, including a stranger, requests a workspace whose clone_status is not ready
criteria.action: refuse before the access decision runs
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not available\n"

criteria.condition: the URL's org slug does not match the workspace's org
criteria.action: refuse before the access decision runs and report no bound refusal
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"

criteria.condition: the workspace row is deleted after the resolver's lookup and before AuthorizeWorkspaceAt reads it
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n"

requirements.title: Workspace without an org
requirements.rationale: A NULL org_id currently yields a 500 that reveals the slug exists, which anti-enumeration forbids.

criteria.condition: any caller, including the owner or an admin token, requests /git/<org>/<slug>.git for a workspace whose org_id is NULL
criteria.action: read the NULL org_id as no org, match no URL org and refuse
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 pkt-line "ERR repository not found\n" instead of a 500

criteria.condition: WorkspaceLoader.Load is asked for a workspace whose org_id is NULL
criteria.action: report the repository as not found
criteria.contract: returns transport.ErrRepositoryNotFound

requirements.title: Existing tests keep their assertions
requirements.rationale: The change must not alter any answer existing gitserver tests assert, except spec 35's git clause this spec supersedes.

criteria.action: pass every existing internal/gitserver test with no assertion changed, where TestAuthz_PATWrongOwner_Returns404, TestAuthz_APIKeyWrongOwner_Returns404, TestResolver_NonOwnerNonAdmin_Returns404 and newBindingGitEnv drop only their seedOrgMember row for the non-owner caller, and TS-33-42..45, 52, 53, 55, 60 and TS-34-58 pass unchanged
change the git case of TS-35-56 (35-REQ-10.6) to expect a member's upload-pack requests to be granted and a member's receive-pack requests to get the member 403, leaving its REST cases unchanged

execution_paths.title: An org member clones and fetches a colleague's workspace

steps.action: runs git clone http://x-token-auth:<member API key>@hub/git/<org>/<slug>.git
resolves the API key to the member's AuthInfo
resolves the workspace, checks the org match and clone_status ready, and calls authorizeGitAccess
derives NeedRead from the upload-pack service and calls wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspaceAt with the git site, which decides AccessMember and grants
serves the ref advertisement and the pack
git clone exits 0; a later git fetch also exits 0 and the local refs equal the owner's refs

execution_paths.title: An org member's push is refused with a read-only 403

steps.action: commits in the clone and runs git push to /git/<org>/<slug>.git with their API key
resolves the ready workspace and calls authorizeGitAccess for GET info/refs?service=git-receive-pack
derives NeedWrite and calls wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspaceAt, which returns 403 "org members have read-only access to this workspace"
writes HTTP 403 with the pkt-line ERR message and returns errAccessDenied before PlainOpen
git push exits non-zero printing the read-only message; the workspace refs, head_sha and audit log are unchanged

symbols.name: AuthInfo
symbols.signature: type AuthInfo struct { CredentialType string; UserID string; Role string; TokenID string; KeyID string; Permissions []string }
symbols.notes: Seen constructed in internal/gitserver/auth.go; source outside the repository.
